name: code-timer
description: Tracks active coding time per repo and injects it into git commit messages.

codeTimer.pauseAfterSeconds.description: Pause timer after this many seconds without keystrokes.

codeTimer.autoStartOnTyping.description: Automatically start the timer when you begin typing.

codeTimer.injectIntoCommits.description: Append elapsed time to git commit messages via a prepare-commit-msg hook.

codeTimer.displayFormat.markdownDescription: Status bar format. Tokens: `{{hours}}`, `{{minutes}}`, `{{seconds}}` (leftover); `{{totalHours}}`, `{{totalMinutes}}`, `{{totalSeconds}}`. Add a label like `{{hours "hr"}}` for `8 hr`, or `{{hours "hr"s}}` to auto-pluralize (`8 hrs`, `1 hr`). Zero-value tokens with a label are omitted.

codeTimer.gitFormat.description: Format used when injecting elapsed time into commit messages. Same token syntax as displayFormat.

codeTimer.promptOnReturn.description: When the timer has auto-paused and you start typing again, show a prompt asking whether to count the time you were away.
